selection: Keep the existing validation-selected checkpoints, learning rates, corrections, and fusion coefficients. No training or selection on test objects.
subset: Exact ID and label matching to the original extra evaluation cohort; all class members retained.
source_audit: Original prediction-file SHA256 checked before subset extraction; cached predictions, not new neural inference.
rng_rule: 20261018 xor first16hex(SHA256(comparison key with _test20000 replaced by _extra20000))
bootstrap: Ordinary paired-object multinomial resampling of joint true-label and both prediction counts; class proportions fluctuate.
interval: Pointwise 95% percentile; conditional on fitted models. No training-seed, model-search or multiplicity correction.
disclosure: The test cohort was examined in prior exploratory analyses. It is the final reported test cohort, not an unopened confirmation cohort.
